text:
Marcus (GTM): Announcing GA: Private VPC Connector (EU region) is GA as of today. This adds explicit data-residency controls for EU customers, a per-tenant private peering option, and a new SLA tier for regional deployments. See the GA notes and customer checklist: https://internal.redwood/priv-vpc/eu-ga (internal).

Elena (Legal): Quick legal note: we now require the updated Data Processing Addendum (DPA-EU-2026) signed before provisioning EU VPC connectors for any customer with EU residency. Sales must attach the DPA to the order. Template here: https://internal.redwood/legal/dpa-eu-2026-template.docx

Asha (Infra): Ops notes: the connector provisions a customer-managed subnet and a peering endpoint. Recommended CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (customer can override but must not overlap). Required outbound ports: 443 (control plane), 1194/4500 (VPN/UDP if using legacy tunnel). If using PrivateLink, only 443. Installer flag to set region: --region eu-west-1. Example CLI: `redwoodctl provision --product private-vpc --region eu-west-1 --cidr 10.40.1.0/24 --peering true`

Marcus (GTM): SLA changes: regional GA adds a 99.9% uptime SLA for dedicated EU connectors (applies to Dedicated + Private customers). For customers who need 99.95% we have an enterprise add-on (requires reserved capacity). Update the SLA appendix in quotes/PSA when offering the GA.

Omar (Sales): Updated playbook and pitch deck uploaded to Sales Drive. Headline bullets: EU residency guarantee, per-tenant isolation, exportable audit logs (s3-compatible), and KMS-integration with customer HSMs. Tagging @sales to review pricing for smaller EU customers — we have a reduced onboarding fee for customers who choose standard peering (vs on-site networking).

Elena (Legal): Also: for vendors in certain regulated sectors we need the 'no-export' contractual clause. If a customer requests this, escalate to Enterprise Legal and change provisioning to deny any external backups.

Asha (Infra): Technical rollout plan: 1) Canary with 3 pilot tenants this week, 2) limited GA for EU customers with signed DPA next week, 3) full rollout in 3 weeks. Eng-oncall: expect networking-related tickets during peering setup window. I pushed a troubleshooting gist for common routing errors: https://internal.redwood/priv-vpc/peering-troubleshoot

policy-bot: DPA-EU-2026 template added to Legal Templates (link: https://internal.redwood/policy-templates/DPA-EU-2026). Reminder: attach DPA when creating provisioning ticket.

Marcus (GTM): Action items: 1) Sales: include DPA link in all EU quotes (Omar), 2) Legal: finalize clause language for no-export (Elena), 3) Infra: publish peering runbook and CLI examples (Asha), 4) GTM: webinar for EU customers Fri 04/01 09:00 CET. Please add blockers to the GA checklist.

Omar (Sales): Will update the quote templates and ping AE leads.

Asha (Infra): Will publish the runbook and a short demo script by EOD tomorrow.

Elena (Legal): Will draft the no-export clause and share for review by EOD Wednesday.

Marcus (GTM): Thanks team. If anyone spots customer-impact items that should delay GA, raise them in the checklist. Otherwise were rolling GA out now. :european_union: :lock:
